name: agy-autonomous-mcp-modeling-plugin
description: Spec-driven autonomous 3D CAD, architectural, and hard-surface modeling in Blender via MCP. Features Building Spec JSON anchoring, rotated plan leveling & metric calibration, section slab elevation fitting, bmesh floor-cut IoU & void-solid verification, native RANDOM shading, reversible Site_Yaw delivery, true structural section profiles (HEB/IPE/louvers/slats/railings), and 5-camera + closeup visual audits.
suggestedPrompts: 根据输入的平立剖面与实景图，先运行 plan_prep 与 section_levels 转正定标并锁定 Building Spec，再按 L1/L2/L3 在 Blender 完成高精度三维建模并通过水平剖切验收
对斜置建筑平面图扫描并纠偏偏航角、建立局部正交网格，识别内天井、悬挑与错层轮廓后生成多视图、节点特写与楼层剖切叠加图
在原生 RANDOM 分色下审校当前 Blender 场景的拓扑、细部台账与各层 z+cut 水平剖切 IoU，修复偏差后执行 finish_materials 与 Site_Yaw 交付
